title: Reframing Genetic Medicine in Terms of Impact
description:
A reproducible research project evaluating genetic medicine in terms of present and prospective impact. The analysis combines a structured disease-by-intervention catalogue, global disease-burden estimates, intervention and access modeling, a reproductive analysis of cases in which no unaffected embryo can be selected, and an exploratory model of how polygenic editing could alter common-disease risk as technological capacity increases. The project distinguishes present impact from the translational germline-editing frontier and future polygenic impact, and separates quantitative results from ethical and regulatory interpretation. Accompanies the manuscript Reframing Genetic Medicine in Terms of Impact.

Code is licensed Apache-2.0; the curated data products are CC-BY-4.0. Third-party inputs (IHME GBD 2023, Orphanet, UN WPP, WHO, UNAIDS, World Bank) remain under their own licenses and are referenced rather than redistributed where their terms require it (notably GBD).
